name: Algebra Evidence Rubric
principle: Judge evidence, not points. Apply only dimensions the task was designed to elicit.

mathematical_accuracy.description: Accuracy of calculations, algebra, graphing, notation, values, units, and mathematical claims.

conceptual_understanding.description: Evidence of the underlying mathematical idea and meaning, not only isolated procedure.

reasoning_justification.description: Logical support, explanation, defense, critique, or evidence when the task calls for it.

representation_communication.description: Correct and meaningful use or connection of graphs, tables, equations, words, diagrams, intervals, number lines, and notation when relevant.

independence_transfer.description: Independent performance and, when appropriate, flexible application in changed contexts or representations.

item_evidence_strength.meaning: No defensible evidence judgment can be made from this response.
Major errors or misconception; little valid evidence of the intended target.
Meaningful correct thinking is present, but incomplete, inconsistent, or undermined by an important gap.
The response substantially demonstrates the intended target independently; minor slips may remain if they do not undermine understanding.
Convincing evidence plus meaningful transfer, connection, critique, modeling, strategic representation use, or successful less-routine application.

portfolio_status.label: Not Yet
portfolio_status.meaning: The current body of evidence does not yet support the target.

portfolio_status.label: Approaching
portfolio_status.meaning: Meaningful evidence is present, but proficiency is incomplete, inconsistent, overly routine, or contradicted by an unresolved issue.

portfolio_status.label: Meeting
portfolio_status.meaning: The body of evidence convincingly supports independent performance of the target with sufficient quality, consistency, and recency.

portfolio_status.label: Exceeding
portfolio_status.meaning: The student meets the target and also demonstrates meaningful transfer, connection, critique, modeling, generalization, or strategic representation use.

pilot_guardrails.meeting_from_exit_tickets_alone: Normally requires at least two independent CONVINCING evidence points for the same target across separate opportunities and no material unresolved contradiction.
